description: This file defines functions to decorate command-line commands for the Playwright MCP (Multi-Client Protocol) server, including setting options for server configuration, browser setup, and installation. It handles command options, server setup, and browser management logic.

methods.name: decorateMCPCommand
methods.description: Adds command-line options and setup logic for the MCP server command, configuring server options, browser options, and server startup behavior.

methods.name: decorateMCPInstallBrowserCommand
methods.description: Adds command-line options and logic to ensure necessary browsers are installed for a specific Playwright version.
